description.value: Herald Street Brew Works is a craft brewery and taproom in Victoria's Old Town, pouring tank-fresh beer directly from 10 bright tanks visible from nearly every seat in the tasting room. The brewery favours constant experimentation over core recipes, releasing an ever-changing lineup of ales, lagers, IPAs, and collaboration brews with neighbouring Victoria breweries. The multi-level space accommodates up to 150 guests and offers event bookings with catering through The Drake Eatery.
